> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Do not modify `skills/`, `plugins/*/skills/`, `index.json`, `skills.sh.json`, or `provenance.json` in this repo.**
> Skill content is maintained by Ramp's publishing pipeline, so hand edits will be
> overwritten and rejected by CI. Open an issue in this repository to propose a skill change.

This repo accepts PRs for catalog-level content only: `README.md`, `PRODUCT.md`,
`docs/`, `.github/`, and plugin-native content under `plugins/`
(manifests, rules, commands, mcp.json — everything except the mirrored `skills/` dirs).
